name: Shake It Off Summer Camp
description_short: Indoor play studio camp in Scarsdale for potty trained children ages 3 to 8, by the half day, full day or single day. Kids do themed crafts, food projects, simple science experiments, music, dancing and bounce time.
refund_policy_summary: No refunds for cancellations, absences, early withdrawal or behavior dismissals; a day canceled for weather earns a credit toward another program.
notes: 2027 summer registration is open. Week rates: AM half days (9 to 12, snack) $365, PM half days (12 to 3, lunch) $370, full days (9 to 3, lunch and snack) $585, extended full days (8 to 5) $699. Day passes: full day $125, AM half day $80, PM half day $85. Staff to child ratio 1 to 6. Campers bring a labeled water bottle and a change of clothes. 2027 dates are on the Sawyer schedule, which refused our fetch. Tween mini camps are on a separate page.
